subject: Trading
title: What Is Resistance?
description: Learn What Is Resistance? in one minute.

hook.text: A stock rallies to $150 twice and gets rejected both times. That ceiling is resistance—where sellers live.

buildup.text: Resistance forms where selling pressure overwhelms buying demand, stopping rallies at the same level.

discovery.text: Resistance often appears at previous highs, round numbers, or levels with heavy past trading volume.

twist.text: When resistance breaks, it's a breakout—and the old ceiling often becomes the new floor.

climax.text: Breakouts above resistance on high volume are among the most reliable bullish signals in trading.

punchline.text: Resistance is just support waiting to flip.

quiz.question: What typically happens when price breaks through resistance?
